 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Occurence'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Occurrence'.**
 
• The word '**Occurrence**' is a **noun** which means 'an incident or event'. **(घटना)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• The occurrence of the event took everyone by surprise.
 
 
 
• **Therefore, the correct answer would be 'Occurence'.**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Harassment -** Aggressive behaviour or repeated unwanted actions intended to disturb or upset someone.**(उत्पीड़न)**
 
• **Supersede - ** To take the place of something previously in use, often because it is more modern or effective.**(प्रत्याहार करना)**
 
• **Exaggerate - **To represent something as larger, better, or worse than it actually is.**(बढ़ा चढ़ा कर कहना)**
